name: example-bodoc-router
title: Bodoc task router
description: Hidden fallback router for the bodoc marketing team. When a free-form prompt matches no vertical trigger, it asks which bodoc deliverable to build, then the daemon hands the conversation off to the chosen vertical plugin.

description_i18n.en: Hidden fallback router for the bodoc marketing team. When a free-form prompt matches no vertical trigger, it asks which bodoc deliverable to build, then the daemon hands the conversation off to the chosen vertical plugin.
description_i18n.ko: 보닥 마케팅 팀용 숨김 폴백 라우터. 자유입력이 어떤 버티컬 트리거에도 매칭되지 않으면 어떤 산출물을 만들지 묻고, 선택된 버티컬 플러그인으로 데몬이 대화를 전환한다.

query.en: Ask which bodoc marketing deliverable to build, then continue in the matching vertical workflow.
query.ko: 어떤 보닥 마케팅 산출물을 만들지 확인한 뒤 해당 버티컬 워크플로로 이어간다.
